description: This file declares the HealthcheckService class, which implements the IHealthcheckService interface. It manages health check pings for servers, using timers and synchronization primitives, and interacts with session server app management.

classes.name: HealthcheckService
classes.description: Implements health check logic, sending pings, handling acknowledgments, and server removal notifications.

methods.name: HealthcheckService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the health check service with session manager, timer factory, and interval.

methods.name: onPingSent
methods.description: Handles the event when a ping is sent to a server.

methods.name: onAckReceived
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment reception for a ping, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: sendPing
methods.description: Private method to send a health check ping.
